copy.tagline_en: Handle business exceptions and HTTP error responses in ABP framework

howto.what: Claude 会自动提供 ABP Framework 的异常处理代码，包括创建业务异常、配置 HTTP 状态码映射、设置错误码和本地化、控制日志级别等。产出是 C# 示例或配置代码。
howto.when: 当你询问 ABP Framework 的异常处理、业务异常、错误码、HTTP 状态码映射或远程服务错误响应时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个自定义业务异常，带有错误码 App:010046。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can help generate ABP Framework exception handling code, such as custom business exceptions, HTTP status mapping, error code localization, log level control, and RemoteServiceErrorResponse JSON examples.
howto.when_en: This skill triggers when you ask about ABP Framework exception handling, business exceptions, error codes, HTTP status mapping, self-logging exceptions, or remote service error responses.

say_en.text: Create a custom business exception with error code App:010046.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a class implementing IHasErrorCode.

say_en.text: How to map UserFriendlyException to HTTP 400 status?
Generate a RemoteServiceErrorResponse JSON for validation errors.
say_en.note: Claude will output a JSON with validationErrors array.
